verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' own features page describes built-in AI (Zia) that answers plain-English questions, spots anomalies in financial data, and turns that data into suggested next steps inside the product. The MCP connector is about external agents, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on what insights or suggestions Zia generates and from which data, independent or hands-on corroboration of quality, and evidence beyond marketing-level taglines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Spot anomalies before they become problems
AI in Zoho Books turns financial data into the next step automatically
